entity.summary: Hong Kong-based licensed centralized virtual asset trading platform operated by Accumulus GBA Technology (Hongkong) Co., Limited, providing account-based virtual asset trading and related regulated platform services.
entity.notes: The current first-party site identifies Accumulus as a Hong Kong licensed virtual asset trading platform operated by Accumulus GBA Technology (Hongkong) Co., Limited. Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission lists the operator, trading as Accumulus, under CE reference BUA970 with a licensing date of 2024-12-18. The regulatory listing is used as operator, identity, and current licensing evidence rather than as a performance endorsement. No exact launch date or lifecycle event is asserted.
